home.title: Gammanyn as Jannooyssyn Dementia & Alzheimer | Golden Moments
home.description: Gammanyn caslyssyn seyr as meigh dy chloie er-voggyl, as eieyn jannooys son sleih ta beaghey lesh dementia ny Alzheimer as nyn giarailee. Gyn recortys, traa ny poyntyn.

home.lede: Gammanyn aashagh caslyssyn, fotograafyn cadjin, as jannooyssyn dy ghoaill taitnys jeu ry-cheilley—ec dty hiu hene.

home.gamesTitle: Gammanyn nod oo cloie nish hene
home.gamesLede: Ta dagh fer kiune, ayns aght dooiney aasit, as aashagh dy ghoaill toshiaght er. Reih fer jeu, soie lhiattee rish lhiattee, as gow shiu keayrt bentyn rish y scaailan.

steps.title: Reih red ennagh cadjin
steps.text: Caslyssyn jeh cappanyn tee, gareyn, kynsheelogheyn as baatyn-shiaull. Gyn lhaih ny reillyn dy ynsaghey hoshiaght.

steps.title: Soie lhiattee rish lhiattee
steps.text: Lhig daue bwoalley er y scaailan. Loayr mychione ny caslyssyn. My nagh vel ad co-reggyrtagh, cha nel eh agh fuirraghtyn rish y nah vowal.

steps.title: Scuirr choud's t'eh maynrey
steps.text: Ta un ghamman ny jannooys slane. Ta “Jeant son nish” er y scaailan kinjagh.

home.stageTitle: Eieyn son jannooyssyn ec dagh ceim
home.stageLede: Kiaull, obbraghyn laaoil, aachooineaghtyn as tullaghnyn kiuney rieughid, er nyn gooieaghey rish ny ta aashagh nish.

stages.title: Y chied cheim
stages.text: Gleash lesh ny t'ad cur taitnys ayn, lesh caghlaaghyn beggey: cheirdyn taitnys, jurnaghyn beggey, gammanyn fockle as plannal ry-cheilley.

stages.title: Y vean-cheim
stages.text: Obbraghyn aashagh, cadjin er nyn mranney ayns keimyn: fillley, sortaghey, kiaull, gammanyn caslyssyn as shooylyn giare.
stages.label: Eieyn y vean-cheim

stages.title: Y cheim s'anmey
stages.text: Aash as kiangley trooid bentyn, feam as reayrt: kiarail laueyn, arraneyn share, caslyssyn as ve ry-cheilley.

home.specificHtml: Shirrey red ennagh er lheh? Prow jannooyssyn as gammanyn son Alzheimer, gammanyn cooinaghtyn meigh, feyshtyn fysseree aashagh ny crosh-feyshtyn.
home.approachTitle: Jannooys rheynnit, cha nel prowaltys cooinaghtyn
home.approachLede: Ta ram “gammanyn inçhyn” jeant er bun bieauid, poyntyn as straihyn. Da dooinney ta beaghey lesh dementia, foddys shen lhiggey orroo myr prowaltys scoill. Ren shin troggal y lurk.
home.approachLink: Cre'n fa ta shin kiaddey myr shoh

principles.title: Cha nel nhee erbee dy choayl
principles.text: Gyn ooryddyr, poyntyn, bea ny coayl. Cha nel caslys elley agh aash, cha nel eh ny vod.

principles.title: Caslyssyn ta tannaghtyn er fakin
principles.text: Enney harrish aachooineaghtyn. Ta co-reggyrtys goaill toshiaght er nyn oaie, myr shen cha nel red erbee dy chooiney er.

principles.title: Freill arrym as aght aasit
principles.text: Focklyn meigh, aashagh as caslyssyn jeh'n theihll firrinagh. Ny jean ymmyd jeh caslyssyn aitt ny glare lhiannoo rieau.

principles.title: Preevaadjagh rere kiaddey
principles.text: Gyn coontyssyn ny soilsheenyn. Cha nel dty chaslyssyn faagail dty ghreie rieau.

guides.title: Kys dy chloie gammanyn ry-cheilley
guides.text: Aght aarloo, bieauid, as cre dy yannoo tra nagh vel gamman taitnyssagh ny sodjey.

guides.title: Tra t'ad gobbal jannooys
guides.text: Oyrryn cadjin son gobbal, as aghtyn meigh dy phrowal reesht ny s'anmey.

guides.title: Reaghey claare-soilshey
guides.text: Teks ny smoo, ny sloo cur-magh, as un ard-scaailan aashagh.

guides.title: Jannooyssyn seyr yn-phrentail
guides.text: Shirraghyn fockle clou mooar, duillagyn daahjee, bingo as kaartyn coloayrtys.

home.researchTitle: Slaynt yn inçhyn: ny ta'n ronsaght gra dy firrinagh
home.researchText: Nod dementia ve er ny lhiettal? Vel gammanyn inçhyn cooney? Cre mychione trostey, bee, cadley as clashtyn? Freagyrtyn aashagh er bun feanish, goaill stiagh raad nagh vel y feanish lajer.
home.appTitle: Golden Moments er iPhone, iPad as Android
home.appText: Ta'n app seyr shoh gobbraghey magh ass moggyl as foddys eh jannoo ymmyd jeh caslyssyn lught-thie t'ou hene er reih, freilt myr coipyn er dty ghreie. Yn un chiaddey kiune: kiare leacyn mooarey, gyn traa, gyn poyntyn.

faq.q: Koid ny gammanyn mie son sleih lesh dementia?
faq.a: Ta cloiaghyn mie aashagh, cadjin as gyn broo erbee: caslyssyn mooarey dy yannoo piyr jeu, sorçhaghey, crosh-feelee aashagh, cur jerrey er shenn-raaghyn cadjin, daaghey, bingo caslys as caartyn coloayrtys. Y reih share, shen yn fer s’taitnyssee lesh y pheagh jiu. Shaghnee reilleyderyn-traa, poyntyn as nhee erbee ta gollrish prowaltys.

faq.q: Vel ny cloiaghyn shaghrynys-inntin shoh nastee?
faq.a: Ta. Ta dagh cloie as duillag-chlou er Golden Moments nastee, gyn coontys, recortys ny laadey neose erbee. Ta ny cloiaghyn roie ayns y jeeagheyder-moggey er çhellvane, claare-screeuyn ny co-earrooder.

Cha nel eh er ve soilshit dy vel cloie erbee lhiettal shaghrynys-inntin, as cha nel Golden Moments gra dy vel eh lhiggey ny lhiettal nhee erbee. Ta ny cloiaghyn ain son taitnys as traa ry cheilley. Ta’n rheynn slaynt inntin ain soilshaghey magh ny ta ronsaghey taishbyney as ny nagh vel eh taishbyney.

faq.q: Vel ny cloiaghyn shoh cooie da peiagh as çhingys Alzheimer orroo?
faq.a: Ta. She çhingys Alzheimer y chooish s’cadjiney jeh shaghrynys-inntin, as ta ny cloiaghyn jeant er e hon: caslyssyn mooarey ta tannaghtyn ry-akin, beggan reihyn, as veg dy chooinaghtyn ny dy yannoo marran. Ta piyral, sorçhaghey as cur jerrey er shenn-raaghyn cadjin bwoalley er fys shenndeeagh ayns ynnyd jeh ynsaghey noa.

faq.q: Nod peiagh as shaghrynys-inntin anmagh orroo jannoo ymmyd jeh ny jantyssyn shoh?
faq.a: Dy mennick, foddee, lesh peiagh ennagh rish nyn gooish. Ghow toshiaght lesh Feddyn y fer cheddin lesh daa chaslys, Piyryn caslys lesh kiare teelan, duillag ghaaghey ny fea tayrn ennal kiune. Jean eh giare, eiyr orroosyn, as scurr tra t’ad er n’ghoaill nyn saie.

Cha nel coontyssyn ny soilshaghey-fysseree erbee er yn ynnyd-eggey shoh. Ta shin jannoo ymmyd jeh Google Analytics dy hoiggal cre ny duillagyn ta goll er jeeaghyn orroo. Cha nel fotografyn ta shiu reih son Piyryn fotograf ry-akin agh ayns y jeeagheyder-moggey eu hene, as cha nel ad rieau goll er laadey seose.

She fwirran beg Golden Moments, jannoo jantyssyn caslys kiune son lughtyn-thie as kiareyderyn, er y voggyl as myr app nastee. Cha nel shin nyn lheeghyn, as cha nel nhee erbee ayns shoh ny choyrle lhee.

healthNotice.title: Oayllys cadjin, cha nel eh ny choyrle lhee
healthNotice.textHtml: Ta’n duillag shoh cur aaghlare er ronsaghey ta soilshit magh son lughtyn-thie. Cha nod eh gra cre ta kiart son un pheagh. Loayr rish fer-lhee roish caghlaa bee, roortys, cadley, lheeys ny bishaneryn. Son boiraneys dooraghtagh ny caghlaaghyn dooraghtagh elley, fow cooney lhee chelleeragh. Lhaih nyn vaghtys oayllys slaynt.

about.title: Jantys Co-rheynnit, Cha Nel Eh Ny Phrowaltys Cooinaghtyn
about.seoTitle: Mychione Golden Moments: Yn Aght Ain
about.description: Cre’n fa nagh vel reilleyder-traa, poyntyn ny straihyn ec cloiaghyn Golden Moments, cre’n fa ta caslyssyn tannaghtyn ry-akin, as cre ta shin as nagh vel shin gra mychione shaghrynys-inntin.
about.lede: Ta Golden Moments jannoo jantyssyn caslys kiune, aashagh oddys kiareyder as peiagh as shaghrynys-inntin orroo goaill taitnys ass ry cheilley.
about.bodyHtml:
Ny ta shin credjal

She yn traa hene bun yn obbyr: coloayrtys, mongey, y taitnys jeh cur daa chaslys ry-cheilley, ny dy liooar soie faggys da cheilley. Cha nel eh son towse y yannoo er peiagh erbee, cur brod orroo ny sodjey, ny red erbee y phrowal.

Ta ram appyn ayns y theihll er nyn groo mychione bieauid, poyntyn, straihyn as keimyn. Da dooiney ta bio lesh dementia, foddys shen çheet orroo myr scrutaght nagh vod ad goll trooid. Chroo shin y contraartys, as ta shin cummal rish ny reillyn shoh:

  • Veg ry-choayl. Gyn clag, poyntyn, earrooder-gleashaghtyn, bioyssyn, straihyn, confetti ny coontey-sheese, er scaailan erbee.
  • Enney roish cooinaghtyn. Ta ny caslyssyn tannaghtyn er taishbyney dy cadjin. Ta greesaghtyn cur cuirrey da coloayrtys as cha nel ad feyshtey er enmyn ny cooinaghtyn rieau.
  • Mooar, aashagh as shickyr. Teks as caslyssyn mooarey, ard-chontrast, as stiureyderyn ta tannaghtyn ’syn un ynnyd.
  • Ooashlid sleih aasit. Caslyssyn jeh’n theihll chiart as focklyn aashagh, meigh. Gyn cartoonyn, moylley arranagh ny leaghyn emoji.
  • Aght aashagh dy ’aagail. Ta “Jeant son nish” ry-akin dagh traa. She eiyrtys mie eh dy scuirr lieh-vollagh.
  • Preevaadjagh dy cadjin. Gyn coontyssyn ny soilsheenyn. Ta caslyssyn ta shiu reih tannaghtyn er y ghreie eu.

Ny nagh vel shin aggyrt

Ta ny gammanyn ain son taitnys as kiangley ry-cheilley. Cha nel ad feyshtey, prowal, towse, lheeys, moandey ny lhiettal dementia ny gorley Alzheimer, as cha lhisagh peiagh erbee reih ad er y choontey shen. Tra ta shin screeu mychione ronsaght er ny duillagyn slaynt-inçhyn ain, ta shin gra dy baghtal c’raad ta’n feanish faase, as cha nel shin kiangley eh rish ny gammanyn ain hene rieau.

Quoi shin

She fwirran beg neuchroghagh Golden Moments. Cha nel shin nyn lheeghyn. Ta ny stiureyderyn ain er nyn screeu voish leeideilys soilshit magh ec sheshaghtyn lheid as y National Institute on Aging as yn Alzheimer’s Association, as ta dagh stiureyder cur magh ny farranyn echey. Lhaih kys ta shin screeu as shickyraghey ny duillagyn ain.

Insh dooin cre yannoo foays

S’mie lhien clashtyn cre ta gobbragh erriu as cre nagh vel, er-lheh voish sleih ta bio lesh dementia, kiarailee lught-thie as obbreeyn obbyr-aash. Cur post-l da {email}.

editorial.title: Kys Ta Shin Screeu as Scrutaghey Ny Duillagyn Ain
editorial.description: Kys ta Golden Moments ronsaghey, screeu, feddyn farranyn as jannoo ass-y-noa ny duillagyn obbyr dementia as slaynt-inçhyn echey, as ny nagh jean shin soilshaghey magh rieau.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Ny farranyn ain

Ta shin cur bun ny stiureyderyn ain er leeideilys theayagh voish sheshaghtyn lheid as y National Institute on Aging, y CDC, yn Alzheimer’s Association, yn Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, y Family Caregiver Alliance as yn NHS, as er ronsaght er ny scrutaghey ec co-obbreeyn lheid as aavriwnyssyn Cochrane as prowallaghyn lheeys mooarey. Ta dagh stiureyder cur sheese ny farranyn ta eh croghey orroo. Ta shin foshley dagh farran roish cur magh eh, as cha nel shin insh agh ny t’eh gra dy feerinnagh.

Kys ta shin screeu

  • Ymmydoil hoshiaght: cre dy yannoo jiu, ayns glare aashagh.
  • Ynrick mychione feanish: ta shin gra “kianglt rish”, “foddys” as “ta’n feanish mestit” tra shen yn irriney.
  • Lesh ammys: ta shin screeu mychione sleih ta bio lesh dementia myr sleih aasit, as cha nel shin jannoo ymmyd jeh glare feyshtee ny glare nairey rieau.
  • Gyn stoo cummit: gyn staydraa, goan, ard-oayllee, studeyrys, aavriwnys ny feanish jeant seose.

Quoi ta scrutaghey ny duillagyn ain

Ta ny duillagyn er nyn screeu as er nyn scrutaghey ec fwirran Golden Moments, lesh cooney voish greieyn-screeu AI son ronsaghey as drafftal. Ta dagh duillag er ny scrutaghey noi ny farranyn echey ec y whirran. Cha nel ny duillagyn ain er ve scrutit ec fer-lhee ny obbree-lhee elley, as cha nel shin aggyrt red erbee elley. T’ad oayllys cadjin, cha nel ad coyrle lheeys.

Ny nagh jean shin soilshaghey magh rieau

  • Aggyrtyn dy vel gamman, bee, stoo-lhieeney, troostey ny cliaghtey lhiettal, lheeys, moandey ny slaney dementia.
  • Prowallyn, feyshtyn ny poyntyn ta cur er credjal dy vel, ny nagh vel, dementia er peiagh ennagh.
  • Coyrle dy ghoaill toshiaght rish, scuirr jeh, ny caghlaa stoo-lheeys erbee.
  • Soilsheenyn ny stoo er ny chooney lesh argid er nyn gashey myr leeideilys.

Lhiassaghey as kiartaghey

Ta dagh duillag taishbyney yn laa v’eh jeant ass-y-noa s’jerree. My vel shiu feddyn marranys ny farran shenn-emshyragh, cur post-l my sailliu da {email} as jean shin scrutaghey eh dy tappee.

faq.title: Feyshtyn as Ansooryn
faq.seoTitle: Gammanyn as Obbraghyn Dementia: Feyshtyn as Ansooryn
faq.description: Ansooryn da feyshtyn cadjin mychione gammanyn as obbraghyn dementia: cre ny gammanyn dy phrowal, cre cho liauyr dy chloie, eieyn da ny keimyn s’anmey, slaynt-inçhyn as preevaadjys.
faq.lede: Ansooryn giare, aashagh da ny feyshtyn s’mennick ta kiarailee feyshtey.

items.q: Cre ny gammanyn share da dooiney ta bio lesh dementia?
items.a: Ta ny gammanyn share cliaghtit, aashagh as gyn broo erbee, as she yn fer kiart cre erbee t’ad goaill taitnys ass jiu. Ta cur caslyssyn ry-cheilley lesh caslyssyn ta ry-akin, sortaghey, jigsaws aashagh, cur jerrey er raaghyn cliaghtit, daaghey as bingo caslyssyn gobbragh dy mie da ram sleih. Shaghnee earrooderyn-traa, poyntyn as red erbee ta gollrish scrutaght.

items.q: Vel ny gammanyn nastee dy jarroo?
items.a: Ta. Ta dagh cloie as stoo ry-chlou nastee, gyn coontys, recortys, laadey neose ny soilsheenyn.

items.q: Cre’n fa nagh vel poyntyn, keimyn ny ooraderyn ayn?
items.a: Ta bieauid as poyntyn caghlaa obbyr thaitnyssagh dys prowaltys, as foddee shen cur nearey ny corree er peiagh. Ta shin freayll y toshiaght er taitnys as traa ry-cheilley, myr shen cha nel red erbee ry-choayl as foddee shiu scuirr ec traa erbee.

items.q: Cre ny jeshaghtyn ta gobbraghey share?
items.a: Gagh laue-fonn, taiblet ny co-earrooder lesh jeeagheyder-wweb noa-emshyragh. Ta taiblet er staik ec boayrd ny saase s'aashagh dy mennick da daa pheiagh dy chloie lhiattee ry lhiattee. Ta co-earrooder glioon kianglt rish çhellveeishan gobbraghey dy mie da possanyn.

items.q: Nod mayd cloie lesh caslyssyn-shoilshey lught-thie ain hene?
items.a: Nod. Ta Photo pairs caghlaa eddyr 2 as 6 caslyssyn-shoilshey ta shiu reih dys cloie co-reggyrtys. Ta ny caslyssyn-shoilshey tannaghtyn ayns dty yeeagheyder-wweb as cha nel ad goll er laadey seose ny sauail.

items.q: Cre cho foddey lhisagh jannooaght tannaghtyn?
items.a: Dy mennick, ta 10 dys 20 minnidyn dy liooar, as ny keayrtyn ta 2 vinnid ny ventyr mie. Cur-my-ner cowraghyn scaaghey ny corree, as scuirr choud’s t’eh foast thaitnyssagh. Cha nel mooadys kiart ayn.

items.q: Cre my nagh vel ad laccal jannoo jannooaght?
items.a: Cur arrym da’n obbal, as prow reesht ny s’anmey ny er aght elley. Foddee obbal çheet rere scaaghey, pioys, gyn ve shickyr, ny gyn foys erbee y ve oc. Jeeagh er nyn stiurey er cre dy yannoo tra t’ad gra nagh vel.

items.q: Cre ny jannooaghyn ta cooie da keimyn s’anmey jeh dementia?
items.a: Aash as ny biallyn: geaishtagh rish kiaull share, masoal laue lesh smerragh, jeeaghyn er caslyssyn-shoilshey ry-cheilley, cummal brolley bog, soie mooie ’syn aer, ny cloie caslys feer aashagh marish peiagh ennagh lhiattee roo. Ta ram eieyn elley ayns nyn stiurey er keimyn s’anmey.

items.q: Vel jannooaghyn ayn da possanyn ayns thie-kiarail?
items.a: Ta. Ta caartyn ry-chlou as eamerey er y scaailan ec Picture bingo, as ta Finish the saying as Conversation cards gobbraghey dy mie tra t’ad lhaiht magh. Ta nyn stiurey da possanyn ayns thieyn-kiarail goaill stiagh mooadys y phossan, soieaghey, as caghlaa son kiedyn mestit.

items.q: Nod cloieyn lhiettal ny moalaghey dementia?
items.a: Cha nel cloie erbee er hennaghtyn dy lhiettal dementia, as cha nel nyn gloieyn gra lheid y red. Ta greesaghey inçhynagh ayns çhymbyllaght sheshoil er soilshaghey vondeishyn beggey ayns ronsaghey da sleih as dementia meen dys meen-vlassagh orroo, agh t’eh shen feer anchasley rish cloie ta lhiettal çhingys. Ta shin çhebbal cloieyn son taitnys as caadjys.

Cha nod, lesh shickyrys. Ta ronsaghey kiangley 14 bun-chooishyn slaynt as saase-veaghee rish gaue dementia, lheid as coayl clashtyn, ard-vroo foalley, neu-ghleashaght chorpagh, as lomarcanys sheshoil. Foddee lhaih orroo leodaghey y gaue da paart dy leih, agh ta ram sleih ta jannoo dagh red dy kiart foast feddyn dementia. Cha nel eh aggair da peiagh erbee rieau.

items.q: Vel trostey shallidagh mie son slaynt yn inçhyn?
items.a: Ta feanish ayns sleih veg as leah, as ta ram jeh’n ronsaghey ayns baaghyn. Foddee trostey ve gaueagh da sleih shinney, er-lheh marish stoo-lheeys çhingys shugyr ny coayl trimmid gyn ynsagh, as cha nel eh kiedit da sleih ta beaghey lesh dementia. Loayr rish fer-lhee roish my vel shiu caghlaa nyn saase-eeanlee.

Gyn coontyssyn ny soilsheenyn. Ta shin gymmydey Google Analytics dy earroo keayrtyn as dy akin cre ny duillagyn ta cooney, as ta dty yeeagheyder-wweb cooinaghtyn my vel shiu er chur sheeanyn boggey er. Cha nel ny caslyssyn-shoilshey ta shiu reih son Photo pairs goll er laadey seose rieau. Jeeagh er y fogrey preevaadjys son ny smoo fysseree.
Cha nel. Ta Golden Moments son aash-ghoail as fysseree chadjin. Son feyshtyn slaynt, loayr rish fer-lhee, as son emerjinsyn cuir fys er 999.

handout.seoTitle: Duillag ry-chlou: Cloieyn Dementia Nastee er-voggyl
handout.description: Duillag ry-chlou un-ghuillag da lught-thie as arreydee mychione cloieyn caslys meen as nastee da sleih ta beaghey lesh dementia, son possanyn-coonee as packadyn-kiarail.
handout.lede: Clou yn duillag shoh da possan-coonee, packad-kiarail ny er dorrys y voayrd-rioee. Jean ymmyd jeh sarey Clou ayns dty yeeagheyder-wweb; cha bee ny tralyn as ny crammanyn er y duillag clouit.
handout.introHtml: Caslyssyn mooarey, focklyn aashagh as veg ry-choayl. Nastee er laue-fonn, taiblet ny co-earrooder, gyn recortys, gyn soilsheenyn, gyn ooraderyn as gyn poyntyn. Soie-jee lhiattee ry lhiattee as gow-jee keayrtyn.
handout.restHtml:
Paart dy choyrlyn

  • Reih traa jeh'n laa tra ta'n peiagh ec nyn share.
  • Toshiaght lesh y reaghys s'assee. Ta kiare claareyn dy liooar.
  • Loayr mychione ny caslyssyn. She'n coloayrtys y chooid share dy mennick.
  • Scuirr choud's t'eh foast taitnyssagh. She eiyrtys mie eh dy lhiggey jeh dy leah.

Chammah er y ynnyd-eggey

  • Stoo nastee ry-chlou: ronsaghey fockle lesh clou mooar, duillagyn daahmee, caartyn coloayrtys as picture bingo.
  • Eieyn jannooaght son dagh keim, as stiuraghyn er cloie ry-cheilley as er kiarail erriu hene.

Son taitnys as traa ry-cheilley. Cha nel eh ny choyrle lheeys, ny phrowaltys ny ny lheeys. Ta Golden Moments goll er soilshaghey magh ec Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.lede: Ta dagh nhee er y voayl shoh nastee dy ymmyd marish cummaltee, olteynyn as lught-kliaghtey, gyn coontys, kieddagh ny taill erbee. Ta'n duillag shoh cooney lhieu toiggal cre t'ayn as kys dy rheynn eh.

organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Clowanyn possan: Ta kaartyn yn-chlou as eamerey er y scaailan ec Bingo caslyssyn, as ta 50 feyshtyn marish reihyssyn ansoor as poyntyn coloayrtys ec feyshtyn fysseree aashagh.
  • Stiuree immeeaght son fwirran as lught-thie, rere keim as sorçh, screeut ayns glare chadjin marish farraneyn. Cur toshiaght marish 101 eieyn immeeaght ny immeeaghtyn possan son thieyn-kiarail.
organizations.restHtml:
Kys ta possanyn jannoo ymmyd jeh

  • Thieyn-kiarail as kiarail cooinaghtyn: bingo caslyssyn ny cur jerrey er y raa er çhellveeish y çhamyr chadjin, lesh un pheposition bentyn rish y scaailan son y phossan.
  • Claareyn laaoil son sleih aasit: ynnyd claareig lesh Piyryn caslyssyn soit er kiare leacyn, son cruinlaghyn giare fer-ry-fer.
  • Lioarlannghyn theayagh: ronseeyn fockle clouit as kaartyn coloayrtys ayns kishtaghyn cooinaghtyn, as y boayl fo lioar-vark er claareigyn lioarlann.
  • Possanyn coonree kiarailee as cafeeyn cooinaghtyn: duillag-rheynn yn-chlou un-duillag son lught-thie dy ghoaill thie maroo.
  • Thieyn-lheihys as reagheydee feayslee: y duillag-rheynn ayns packadyn kiarailee, son nhee erbee sheeoil dy yannoo ec y thie ny rish y lhiabbee.

Ny nagh vel shin jannoo

Ta ny cloiaghyn ayn son taitnys as traa ry-cheilley. Cha nel ad lheeys, prowal, towse, cur laue er ny cur moal er mee-cheeayllys, as ta shin guee er reagheydyssyn dyn cur y lheid jeh coontey orroo. Cha nel soilsheenyn ayn, as cha nel ny cloiaghyn shirrey enmyn, fysseree slaynt ny caslyssyn dy ve laadit seose. Ta'n voayl-eggey jannoo ymmyd jeh Google Analytics dy earroo keayrtyn; ta'n fogrey preevaadjys ain soilshaghey cre ta shen çhaglym. Ta caslyssyn ymmydit ayns Piyryn fotograf tannaghtyn 'sy ronsagheyder.

Cur shin er dty rolley cooid

My t'ou freayll rolley cooid son kiarailee, ta failt ort kiangley rish {domain}. Foddit oo jannoo coip jeh'n derrey choontey ny'n jeh elley.
organizations.linksHtml:
Duillagyn ymmydoil dy chiangley roo dy jeeragh: cloiaghyn nastee, nheeghyn yn-chlou nastee, immeeaghtyn son Alzheimer's as kys dy chloie ry-cheilley.

Feyshtyn ny kiartaghyn

My ta red erbee er y voayl aggairagh ny neulhoobagh, ny mannagh vel feme cummaltagh er ny chooilleeney liorish ny t'aynshoh, cur fys dooin ec {email}, my sailliu. My sailliu, ny cur roish fysseree persoonagh ny slaynt mychione cummaltee ny lught-kliaghtey.

app.title: Yn App Golden Moments
app.seoTitle: Yn App Golden Moments son iPhone as Android
app.description: Yn app nastee Golden Moments: co-phiyraghey caslyssyn aashagh lesh kiare leacyn mooarey, caslyssyn lught-thie freilt er dty chorys hene, packadyn caslys jeh-linney as gyn coontys erbee.
app.lede: Dagh nhee t'ou cur soylley jeh er y voayl-eggey, ayns app ta gobbraghey jeh-linney as oddys jannoo ymmyd jeh caslyssyn lught-thie t'ou hene er reih.
app.bodyHtml:
Toshiaght veg

Gow toshiaght lesh kiare leacyn mooarey as caslyssyn cannooagh. Freill ny caslyssyn ry-akin, ny keil ad tra t'eh shen ny smoo aashagh. Cha nel oorysheyder, poyntyn ny kerraghey erbee 'sy vodd meein. Reih 4, 6, 8 ny 12 leacyn.

Jean eh persoonagh

Reih caslyssyn teaghleagh lesh reihder caslyssyn dty ghreie. Ta'n app sauail coipyn ny sloo son ny h-obbraghyn echey. Cha nel eh scanrail dty lioarlan ny caghlaa dty chaslyssyn bunneydagh, as t'eh freill seose gys 24 caslyssyn ayns un chruinnaght.

Jeeaghyn ry-cheilley ynrican

Jeeagh er un chaslys ec un traa. Ta coyrlyn reihyssagh cur failt er cooish gyn briaght er peiagh erbee dy chooinaghtyn er enmyn ny cur freggyrt kiart. Ta jeeaghyn ynrican liooar.

Ass-linney raad t'eh scanshoil

Ta caslyssyn toshee as dagh fer jeh ny hoght bundeilyn caslyssyn goaill stiagh 'syn app. Ta coipyn jeh caslyssyn currit stiagh gobbraghey ass-linney. Foddee dy bee feme ec reih caslyssyn bunneydagh ta tashtit ayns iCloud ynrican er kiangley eddyr-linney.

Gyn coontys, gyn server co-syncal caslyssyn

Ta coipyn jeh caslyssyn teaghleagh tannaghtyn 'syn app er y ghreie. Foddys oo scughey ny coipyn gyn dollaghey ny caslyssyn bunneydagh. Foddee dy bee fysseree yn app goaill stiagh ayns coipyn-sauail y ghreie. Lhaih polasee preevaadjys yn app, as ta cooney yn app ginsh dagh keim.
app.disclaimer: Ta Golden Moments son aash-ghoaillys as co-loayrtys ry-cheilley. Cha nel eh scrutaghey, lheeys, lhiettal ny towse dementia ny doghan Alzheimer.

faq.q: Cre'n gamman lhisagh shin goll toshiaght lesh?
faq.a: She reih toshee kiune eh Jeesyn caslys lesh kiare leacyn. My ta reih eddyr caslyssyn ro-streeanagh, prow Gow y fer cheddin lesh daa chaslys. Son possan, prow Bingo caslyssyn.

faq.q: Vel ny gammanyn gobbraghey er iPad ny çhellvane?
faq.a: Ta. Ta dagh gamman gobbraghey 'sy vronseyr er çhellvaneyn, claa-cho-earrooderyn as co-earrooderyn, as ta ny caslyssyn aase dy lhieeney yn scaailan. S'mennick dy vel claa-cho-earrooder er shassooys ny s'aashaghey son daa pheershoon.

faq.q: Vel ny gammanyn shoh mie son peiagh ennagh ta beaghey lesh Alzheimer?
faq.a: Ta. V'ad jeant son sleih ta beaghey lesh dementia, goaill stiagh Alzheimer, y cheooid smoo cadjin. Ta ny caslyssyn tannaghtyn ry-akin, cha nel agh kuse veg dy reihyssyn ayn, as cha nel veg fo traa ny fo poyntyn, myr shen ta ny gammanyn barrantagh er enney cur er reddyn cannooagh ny shlee na cooinaghtyn er reddyn noa.

faq.q: Vel ny gammanyn shoh nyn gammanyn cooinaghtyn son sleih shinney?
faq.a: T'ad nyn gammanyn co-reggyrt as caslyssyn foddee dooinney erbee ny shinney taitnys y ghoaill assda, agh t'ad troggit gyn provail y chooinaghtyn: ayns Jeesyn caslys ta ny caslyssyn tannaghtyn foshlit er nyn oaie mannagh reih oo dy chaghlaa. Ta'n stiurey ain son gammanyn cooinaghtyn son sleih shinney ta beaghey lesh dementia feyshtey cre'n aght dy reayll gamman cooinaghtyn erbee meein.

faq.q: Vel gammanyn ayn son possanyn ayns thie kiarail?
faq.a: Ta. Ta caartyn yn-chlouee as garagheyder er-scaailan ec Bingo caslyssyn, as ta Cur jerrey er y raa as Caartyn cooish gobbraghey dy mie tra t'ad lhaiht magh dy ard gys possan.
